system.description:
You create a vortex that spins counterclockwise just before an attack hits you. Make a contested Ninshou Check vs the jutsu save DC of the triggering jutsu. If you roll higher, the triggering jutsu’s effect is dispelled and the caster of the jutsu takes the damage of their own Jutsu. On a failure, this jutsu is dispelled and you suffer the effects of the triggering jutsu as if you failed your saving throw or the enemy scored a critical hit.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, this jutsu can be cast as a Reaction, when you or an allied creature within 30 feet of you would suffer the effects of or take damage from, a Ninjutsu. On success, the triggering creature suffers the effect of their jutsu as well.
